args.subject: Invoice NBL-013-INV-09 – 8 Brackenmere Walk, Vellumbrook, ZZ1 1ZZ
args.body: Hello Sella, we have received your invoice NBL-013-INV-09 dated 10 September 2025 for supplying and fitting 1 pane of glass to the kitchen glazing at 8 Brackenmere Walk, Vellumbrook, ZZ1 1ZZ. The amount on our copy is blank. We also have no record of a visit: on 2 September the glass had not yet arrived. Could you please confirm: (1) the date the glass was fitted and that the work is complete; (2) the invoice amount, with a corrected copy. The approved price was £150 plus VAT (£180 in total). (3) Any completion photos you have. We can't pass the invoice to the landlord until we have these. Thank you.

args.reason: Waiting for Provider: confirmation the glass was fitted, visit date and invoice amount (invoice copy blank).

args.summary: Invoice uploaded with a blank amount and no record of the glass being fitted. Asked the contractor to confirm completion, the visit date and the invoice amount. Follow-up set for 2025-09-13.
facts: Landlord was told £150 + VAT, £180 total (event 9). He replied he was happy to use the contractor if £180 was the total (event 10). The quote was recorded as approved (event 12).
On 2 Sep the contractor said the glass had still not arrived and no appointment was arranged (event 21).
Event 22 (9 Sep) records no appointment confirmation or visit report.
Invoice NBL-013-INV-09 dated 10 Sep says 'Supply and fit 1 pane of glass' but the amount is blank (event 23, glazing-invoice.pdf).
conflicts: An invoice for supply and fit exists, but no visit or completion is recorded and the glass was still undelivered on 2 Sep (events 21-23).

The approval note records the quote as approved (event 12). The landlord's reply was conditional on £180 being the total (event 10). These are consistent if £150 + VAT = £180, which the contractor has not confirmed.
missing: Confirmation the glass was fitted, and the date
Invoice amount, with a corrected copy
Whether the tenant's damp and cold concern was resolved. No assessment is recorded (event 5).
options_rejected: Forward the invoice to the landlord for payment: there is no amount and no proof of completion.
Approve the invoice: no amount to check against the quote.
Close the case: there is no completion evidence and the final checks have not been done.
Escalate: one message to the contractor can settle it, and the contractor is responsive.
args.uncertainty: The work may have been done between 2 and 10 Sep without being recorded. The contractor has not replied to the request yet.
